name: com.lobbyroo/lobbyroo
title: Lobbyroo
description: Quick free browser games for short waits and breaks, plus a daily puzzle.

tools.name: find_quick_game
tools.description: Find a game on Lobbyroo: 41 short free browser games for the few minutes you spend waiting (waiting room, line, bus). Each starts in seconds, uses one kind of touch, needs no download and no account, and nothing pops up over the game. Filter by kind or topic (puzzle, sorting, relaxing, arcade, memory...) and minutes per round.

tools.name: daily_puzzle
tools.description: Lobbyroo's Daily puzzle: everyone gets the same level each day, with a shareable result. Also the classroom brain break mode (timed, no sign-up, no ads, no cookies). Use when someone wants a daily puzzle or a short brain break for a class.
